notes.title: Homebound, At Last.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/3ea06cc245bc291d4f23d4bffaf7bf66b0bfc9a3.jpg[/img]

Ladies, gents, and the rhythm between the lines,
The wait is over! Every fiber of my being is overwhelmed with relief and gratitude as I bring you the news:

🎸 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599780/Afterlove_EP/][b]Afterlove EP is out now![/b][/url] 🎸

I can’t find the words to fully express what this moment means. Seeing the overwhelming support for our game has been nothing sort of incredible. Every message, kind word, and moment you spend with Afterlove EP means the world and more.

This project was always more than just a game. It began as the story aching in Fahmi’s chest, one he longed to share with the world. Then, it became our way, Pikselnesia’s way, of saying goodbye - to his presence, his guidance, his boundless passion. And now, it’s yours. Please, take this journey. Let the music, the love, and the memories carry you through the world he imagined.

Many of us on the team, including myself, worked on What Comes After with Fahmi before we embarked on this project. Even then, he was already shaping the early whispers of what was, at that time, called Project Heartbreak. Fahmi wasn’t just a writer - he was a storyteller first and foremost. He always led with feeling. And this time, he wanted to capture the raw aching of trying to move on from love while its voice still lingers in your mind. 

With his passing, that feeling became something more to us. Something raw, and real. I knew, deep in my bones, that my role now was to wrestle that same grief, fresh and unrelenting in my mind, and trap it within the frame of Afterlove EP. To make sure his vision wasn’t just heard, but felt.

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for staying with us until the end. Because of you, we weren’t so alone in this grueling path. Now, I can’t wait for you to step into Rama’s worn canvas shoes, to walk Jakarta’s streets, to hear its music, to feel its love. When you do, let me know what you think - I’d love to hear it.

This is my last personal post, so I suppose this is a farewell - but I hope we meet again, in another story, in another rhythm.

Until then,

Sasha Ariana

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/6196c249ff74028e26c1da3cafdaa4b429355c72.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Come celebrate Fahmi’s birthday with us!
notes.content:
It’s Fahmi’s birthday today. He would have been 35.

He wasn’t one to make a big fuss about the day - I suppose that was how he was raised. But I grew up in a family that makes big deals out of birthdays. So, one year, I asked him if it was okay if I celebrated with him. He laughed at the fact that I felt the need to ask but admitted that it made him feel loved.

So here I am, three years after his passing, still making a big deal out of it. Because he deserves it. And I’d love for all of you to join in celebrating his legacy too. 

If you have a memory to share, or just want to talk about Fahmi and his games, leave us a comment below, or you can find and tag us via the @pikselnesia handle on Twitter/X and Instagram.

We’re racing toward the release of Afterlove EP at what feels like neck-breaking speed now. As we count down to Valentine’s Day, I’m excited to share that we’ve put together something special to honor Fahmi’s birthday and his legacy: [b]The Love After Coffee[/b] Bundle. It includes [b]Coffee Talk[/b], [b]What Comes After[/b], and [b]Afterlove EP[/b] - and it’ll be available when Afterlove EP launches on February 14th, 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/2da6afbb56d72a3223cc6c1960e6aa2c05168774.png[/img]

We are so close to the finish line, so close to fulfilling the dream Fahmi entrusted to us, to Pikselnesia. Thank you so much for sticking with us on this journey.

Until then,

Sasha Ariana

notes.title: Dev Blog #1: We have a date... it’s you!
notes.content:
Greetings, my friends, and Happy New Year! Hope it’s been good to you so far!

Sasha here, the Narrative Designer for Afterlove EP. On behalf of the Pikselnesia team, I’m thrilled to kick off 2025 with some amazing news that’s got me practically vibrating with excitement:

[h2]Afterlove EP releases on February 14th, 2025![/h2]

[previewyoutube=g5UhUVaYGpg;full][/previewyoutube]

Honestly, I can’t think of a better date for all of us to come together and share in this creation - this labor of love we’ve poured our hearts into. Please come celebrate the day of love with Rama and get your hands on Afterlove EP that day!

This game has been a deeply personal journey for our team. As some of you might have noticed from how often I talk about him, Afterlove EP was the dream project of our late director, Mohammad Fahmi Hasni, who passed away in 2022. Completing it has been a way for us to honor Fahmi’s vision, his passion for storytelling, and his insistence on talking non-stop in my head.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/acfa23dfaee1cece8b4b1fe966036f6db11b326b.jpg[/img][i]In loving memory of Fahmi.[/i]

Also, since we’re talking about Fahmi, a little heads up: his birthday is coming up on January 29th, and we’ve planned something special to celebrate it with you. Stay tuned - we’re kicking off 2025 in delirious excitement, and you won’t want to miss what’s coming next. Mark your calendars, and we’ll see you soon.

Take good care of yourself until then, and get ready for an unforgettable Valentine’s Day!

Sasha Ariana

notes.title: Afterlove EP Progress Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/e39b593daa94e0c7a0b2ed0ce20d46b1f4a0e874.png[/img]

To our wonderful Afterlove EP fans,

We hope these words find you as well as can be. Today, we wanted to share an important update about our upcoming release that we’re excited—and humbled—to bring to you.

We wanted to give you a pretty significant update as to where we are in production. 

First off, we’re delighted to let you know that Afterlove EP will feature Japanese and Indonesian localization, bringing this unique experience to even more players around the world. Given Fahmi’s vision and passion for Japanese culture, combined with the popularity of the Soyatu, the game’s primary artist, localising the game into Japanese was a no brainer. We deeply hope our Japanese fans enjoy the game. We also wanted to honor the origins of Fahmi and PIKSELNESIA and make sure that, as the game is a love letter to Jakarta and our home, that folks around us would have no barriers in playing our game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/46ce556d625d5f70969ff822e8292e7628b8b57b.png[/img]

Since we hit Beta a few months back, we have done a ton of work collecting feedback through some closed playtesting rounds and with the assistance of some excellent QA houses. As the game has multiple narrative branches and a calendar, we worked closely with QA to perform logic testing and pacing the game became incredibly important to make sure our story and your choices just made sense while you explore Rama’s life and someone didn’t say “it’s nice to meet you” after you’ve already had several conversations, a coffee, and a conversation about records with them.

Our final script weighs in at over 125k words, easily a hefty novel and we can’t thank Sweet Baby Inc. enough for their assistance in helping craft Fahmi’s vision of a story of love and loss, under the direction of our Narrative Director Galuh “Sasha” Elsa. It’s been a labor, to be sure,  but one we’ve done happily and are very proud of to make sure that it doesn’t just play like we want it to, but [i]feels[/i] how we want it to.

In addition, we’re very happy to share that the game has also been sent off to the porting houses who are hard at work making sure that the game is available to as many players as we’re practically able to. So whether you’re on Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, or Nintendo Switch, you’ll be able to get your hands on it on your preferred platform.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/abb3b1f15c9e043f829ab3e67a24111e576e57bd.png[/img]

To ensure that Afterlove EP meets the high standards we’ve set for it—and that we expect—we’ve decided to shift the release date in order to polish and craft every detail as best we can while the above work is happening. We understand this might be disappointing to some, but this extra time will allow us to deliver an experience that meets not only your, but our, expectations. We get one shot at this and we want to make sure we get it right.

Our new release window is set for Early 2025, and while we know it’s a bit further out than originally planned, we truly believe it will be worth the wait. But you won’t be waiting long. We’ve started putting our release date trailer together, so we’re going to be able to give you a solid release date soon. 

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional game that reflects the passion and dedication we’ve poured into it. We can’t do any less for Fahmi or the people looking forward to exploring Jakarta and following Rama’s journey.

We’re on the cusp of completing a project that’s been a true labor of love for our team, and in particular, for Fahmi, whose creative vision has shaped every aspect of this game. Afterlove EP is truly Fahmi’s masterpiece, and it’s been a remarkable journey in bringing it to life. Our aim has always been to create something truly special, and we’re almost there.

We are so grateful for your continued support. We can’t wait to share this journey with you and see how you connect with and experience Afterlove EP when it’s finally ready.

Stay tuned for more updates, and in the meantime, please feel free to reach out with any questions or thoughts. Your enthusiasm means the world to us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/f1c875866f5b2cc8dd2aefb918cb76d333c63437.png[/img]

notes.title: What working on Afterlove EP has meant to us
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/37a21eaaca68530b1eeb2c8a24bb5b66dae92141.png[/img]
We are so, so happy to announce the release of the Afterlove EP Demo as a part of LudoNarraCon!

We at Pikselnesia are honoured to be carrying this game, Fahmi’s vision, forward to release. He loved this story, and he loved Jakarta, and we all miss him terribly. We want to do right by him and his vision.

Getting this far has been the result of a lot of love and a lot of work and we wanted to take a moment to reflect, introduce ourselves, and share with you all what working on Afterlove EP, and carrying on Fahmi's legacy has meant to us.

[b]Giri (Lead Programmer)[/b]
[i]For me, working on the Afterlove EP is a way of my gratitude to Fahmi. He connects us in every way to be a ragtag bunch of misfits. I'm not a great storyteller myself, but he helped me to realise that every person has their own best way to express their capability into one great story. Afterlove EP embodies that idea, a bundle of contributions from each of us to deliver his final story.[/i]

[b]Dany (Game Director and Programmer)[/b]
[i]Working on Afterlove EP is such a roller coaster for me. Fahmi and I were the same age and pretty much from the same area. I often butted heads with Fahmi on some aspects of the game, but working with him showed me how clear his visions for this game are, and I love the collaborative spirit of it. It makes me want to help him create this art faster. To get it out to people. The team is also very supportive and communicative, and maybe that is why we keep going even after he's gone. I just want to make him think "Ah, I was right to choose those guys to work with, I can leave it to them to complete the game.[/i]

[b]Soyatu (Lead Art)[/b]
[i]For me, it's my great journey of my life. its my first time working on game world, and its challenging! it's an honor to be invited to involved. Big thanks to Fahmi who made us united.

And Fahmi said back then "you can draw anything you want" is super love energy.
I personally think, all of team are artists and we are creating a work of art (but also a great game).

I hope Pikselnesia’s messages are delivered to the players! Thank you so much.[/i]

[b]Ivor (Game Producer)[/b]
[i]Working on Afterlove EP for me is a chance! A chance to work on an Indie Game! A chance to work with amazing people around the world! A chance to challenge myself! And of course, a chance to work on Fahmi's masterpiece![/i]

[b]Pinga (Background Artist)[/b]
[i]Working on Afterlove EP means to be on a wonderful journey. It's been my first step in games or working in the industry ever, and getting to know a lot of good and inspiring folks.

Though now, it also means to continue what Fahmi has shared and taught. Not enough words can tell how I adore him as a lead and creative person. I wish he can be here, involved in all these processes.[/i]

[b]Sasha (Lead Narrative Designer)[/b]
[i]Fahmi saw within me a blooming light and sought to nurture it. He confided in me his vision of his perfect game, and trusted me to help him make it come true. We sacrificed parts of ourselves to perfect that image, and thus his departure devastated me so. Completing his masterpiece is the one thing within my capability to make sure he lives on in the hearts of many.[/i]

Thank you so much for coming on this journey with us and we hope you enjoy the demo! There is more to come and we can't wait to tell you about it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599780/Afterlove_EP/

notes.title: Afterlove EP - Major Update on our Progress, Platforms and Launch Timing
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/7c1dc8c678eb3b1d9a9b8c4033af3f94bc63dd9c.png[/img]Hi everyone,

We’ve been quiet for a long time but today we’d like to give a major update on Afterlove EP; what’s been happening with the development since the tragic passing of our beloved Fahmi; where we’re at in development and when to expect the release. We’re also very pleased to share some new screenshots and give you a look at how far the game has progressed.

This is a big update (you may want to grab a cup of coffee or tea) but we wanted to be as transparent and share as much as we can considering we have been quiet for so long. 

But before we get into it, we’d first like to thank you all. It has been a tough journey for us over the last 18 months and we really appreciate your patience and support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/b1a2d79e42a12cc0ca67ec20aabf4cde85f06fd3.png[/img]

[h2]Who is Pikselnesia?[/h2]
Firstly, we thought it would be a good idea to introduce ourselves a little more and tell you who Pikselnesia is.

Pikselnesia is a fully remote indie games studio based in Indonesia. The team was established by Fahmi in 2020, specifically for the Afterlove EP project. 

All together there are nine of us in the Pikselnesia team, located in various places around Indonesia. We are all indie game developers and most of us have been working on the game part time alongside other jobs. In addition we have support on Audio from three of the team at [url=https://monkeymelody.com/]Monkey Melody[/url], an audio post-production studio & audio localization company for multimedia products. Monkey Melody Composed BGM and SFX for ALEP.

Many of us had worked with Fahmi on his previous project, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1421760/What_Comes_After/]What Comes After[/url], and we’ve also worked on other games like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201270/A_Space_for_the_Unbound/]A Space for the Unbound[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789090/Hello_Goodboy/]Hello Good Boy[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/3b4ff3323b59def0e94ae2abf6bb7f3d659e86ed.png[/img]
[h2]Development for the last 18 months[/h2]
When Fahmi passed away in March 2022 it hit the team extremely hard. It was most of all the loss of a beloved friend.

After some time to grieve we came together to talk about the question of what to do about the game. The decision of the team was unanimous - we all committed to bring Fahmi’s vision for Afterlove EP to fruition.

At this point we were quite a long way into pre-production. However, Fahmi was both the Creative Director and narrative lead and so the task of working out how to carry on without him was not a simple matter.

Whilst we were able to get back into production of some areas such as art and coding quite soon, we had big shoes to fill on the narrative side of things and that took much more time to work through.

We had the core of the story, characters and narrative design and so Fahmi’s vision was clear, but the work to bring that all into the game was still in its early stages.

Our biggest challenge would be staying true to Fahmi’s vision whilst still going through the same approach you need for a high quality narrative game, namely changing things that aren’t working, iterating and polishing.  

This was not something we could rush into so we took some time to determine the best way forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/42c4b3067edb4f77602b2fe0b2bbc4ecc158b5e4.png[/img]
Our decision was for [url=https://twitter.com/gal__el?lang=en]Sasha Ariana[/url] from our team to step up as lead narrative designer and to bring in [url=https://sweetbabyinc.com/]Sweet Baby Inc[/url], a narrative development and consultation studio to support on the narrative design and writing. 

Sasha had been working hand in hand with Fahmi on the narrative of Afterlove EP and was also part of the team on his previous game, What Comes After. She intimately understands his vision and style as well as how to ensure the authentic Indonesian culture and vibe remains at the heart of the project. Besides her work on Afterlove EP, and What Comes After, Sasha was heavily involved in the narrative design and writing for A Space for the Unbound.

Sweet Baby are a team of writers and narrative designers lead by [url=https://twitter.com/BagelofDeath]Kim Belair[/url] and have worked on 25+ projects including an extensive collaboration on Playdate games, indies like Sable, and AAA games like God of War: Ragnarok, South of Midnight and Alan Wake II. Fahmi had been talking with Sweet Baby about joining the project as consultants shortly before he passed and they have been extremely supportive and a huge help in taking on this larger role.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/7a236e56b96acbc2713a4b8ceb1d5499369e636d.png[/img]
[h2]Where are we now?[/h2]
Whilst this all took some time, we’re pleased to say that we recently completed the first draft of the writing for the whole game and can now play it from start to finish. This is a very exciting moment for us as it’s the point where we can start to see what is working and what isn’t and begin the crucial iteration phase.

Meanwhile, most of the rest of the development is at the final stages with all the coding complete and almost all the art in place.  The audio and music is also almost all in place with just a couple of last bits to do on the soundtrack and Cinta’s VO to be recorded once the script is final.

We’re delighted to share a new batch of screenshots today to give you a look at the game as it is today including some new locations and characters we’ve not shown before.

And if you’d like to check out the soundtrack early, [url=https://linktr.ee/lalphalpha]L’Alphaalpha[/url] have just released the album they recorded for the game and you can listen right now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/6e4588049413782404fe2a18476bbe92493eff5d.png[/img]

[h2]What’s next?[/h2]
Now that we can play the whole game we’re focused on playing, testing, reviewing and updating and repeating this process until the game is at the quality we want to achieve.

We are aiming to have this complete by the end of this year and from there we will go into localisation and console porting alongside a final phase of bug fixing and polish.

Talking of consoles, we’re very pleased to reveal that we have a console porting partner onboard in [url=https://pocketsizedhands.com/]Pocket Sized Hands[/url]. We will be handling the Nintendo Switch version ourselves and Pocket Sized Hands will be working on the PlayStation versions we already announced and we are very excited to announce that they will also be working on Xbox versions, meaning we will now release on PC and all of the consoles.

This localisation and porting will take a while and releasing on so many platforms means there is a lot more coordination and planning to do for the launch. We now expect to launch the game in Q3 2024.

Now that we have things moving along so well we finally feel comfortable starting to talk about the game again and to have some confidence in giving this new release date.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40379882/e056a071b6a727bb87aaf5d1554e743e5efdbaa4.jpg[/img]

You can expect to hear more from us and our publisher, [url=https://fellowtraveller.games]Fellow Traveller[/url], in the coming months and, most excitingly, we are looking forward to bringing you a playable demo in early 2024.

The best way to stay across news on Afterlove EP is to subscribe to the [url=https://games.us7.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=cd14f5a5383a6733b23c13e61&id=8cbc39e2d9]Fellow Traveller newsletter[/url] and join the [url=https://discord.gg/sk89hQj57x]Fellow Traveller discord[/url]. 

You can also wishlist the game on the platform of your choice and of course follow Pikselnesia on twitter.

Thank you again for your patience and for reading all the way to the bottom of this post! We can’t wait to show you more of Afterlove EP soon.

The Pikselnesia Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1599780/Afterlove_EP/

notes.title: Announcing Afterlove EP
notes.content:
We here at Fellow Traveller are excited to reveal that we’re working with Mohammad Fahmi (Coffee Talk) and Pikselnesia on Afterlove EP, the game previously known as “Project Heartbreak”! 

Unique elements of narrative adventure, rhythm game, and dating sim blend together in this poignant ‘slice-of-life’ story about love, loss, and music. Afterlove EP is coming in 2022, and is available to wishlist now.

[b]What does love truly mean?[/b]

Set in Indonesia, a young musician named Rama suddenly finds himself alone in the bustling metropolitan city of Jakarta after his girlfriend, Cinta, unexpectedly passes away. Cinta’s voice lives on, narrating Rama’s every moment. He must overcome his grief and learn that moving on isn’t about forgetting the past, but cherishing it.

[b]Experience the culture of Jakarta, Indonesia’s capital[/b]

Inspired from an indie-manga art style, watch the city come to life through everyday conversations and interactions with Rama’s friends and neighbors. The game features landmarks and settings inspired by real world Jakarta locations.

AfterLove EP’s soundtrack also bolster’s the game’s authentic representation of Indonesian culture, composed by Jakarta indie band, [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/46ipdIq678HcnKpQqYFPuh]L'alphalpha[/url]. The soundtrack will feature brand new tracks from the band inspired by AfterLove EP’s story and written and performed in Indonesian (with English translations included in-game).

[b]An extraordinary, ordinary life[/b]

During the game, players will live within the culture of Jakarta and help Rama create music, socialise with friends, make life choices, and maybe even learn to love again.

Rama’s interactions with friends and neighbors are split between day and night for short but meaningful bursts of gameplay. Containing an unconventional blend of elements drawn from adventure games, dating simulators and rhythm games, AfterLove EP will have players navigating Rama through new potential relationships, jam sessions with his band, and working on an EP of songs that he promised Cinta before she passed away.

Stay tuned with AfterloveEP updates as they go live by wishlisting Afterlove EP now and following Pikselnesia and Fellow Traveller on Twitter!
